label: Linear size from Euler's formula
subgoals: Model the diagram as a planar graph with degree at least 3
Apply Euler's formula with one face per site
Bound the vertices by 2n minus 5 and the edges by 3n minus 6

label: Unbounded cells and the hull
subgoals: Compute the convex hull of the sites
Mark each hull site as having an unbounded cell
Count the unbounded cells as the hull sites

label: Exact counts and metrics
subgoals: Use the vertex count 2n minus 2 minus h in general position
Use the edge count 3n minus 3 minus h
Note how L1 or L-infinity metrics change the bisectors
